page.overview:
Who is Iolo Arana?

Iolo Arana was a Keshian male starfighter pilot who served as a lieutenant in the New Republic Starfleet and as a member of Rapier Squadron. He ultimately joined the Resistance—along with fellow squadron members commander Poe Dameron and lieutenant Karé Kun—during its conflict with the First Order. As a member of the Resistance, he was promoted to the rank of captain and given command of Dagger Squadron.

Iolo Arana was a starfighter pilot who flew in the New Republic Defense Fleet's Rapier Squadron, which flew T-85 X-wings in the Mirrin sector. He answered to the callsign Rapier Three and his comrades included Commander Poe Dameron, Lieutenant Karé Kun, and Muran.

At some point, Arana and the rest of the squadron were stationed at the Brooksdion New Republic space station. While they were hanging out at the local bar, Arana ordered a drink from the bartender Quinny. In response to Dameron's musings about his desires, Arana made light of Dameron's competitive nature. An alarm then sounded at the station and Rapier Squadron was called to their ships. Dameron was soon informed that the head of Admiral Mathieson's protocol droid had been stolen and it was suspected that a small passenger ship had been used to transport it off the station. Arana along with the rest of the squadron called out their call signs before flying off, chasing after the passenger ship. After discovering the passenger ship's whereabouts, Dameron shot out its hyperdrive and called out a warning. The ship however attempted to distract and elude them forcing them to give further chase. The squadron was then informed that Admiral Mathieson was giving them direct orders to shoot down the ship. Dameron then directed the squad to fire at the ship but the ship managed to avoid getting hit and headed for the Lost Souls asteroid field. Dameron ordered the rest of the squad to pull up while Dameron pursued the ship alone into the field.

During one of their routine patrols in the Mirrin sector, Arana and his squadron responded to a distress message from the freighter Yissira Zyde near Suraz 4. Rapier Squadron were subsequently caught up in a dogfight with First Order TIE/fo space superiority fighters which ended with the death of Muran.
